profile_name.description: Unique name for the AppArmor profile (no spaces or quotes needed unless special chars)

abi_version.description: ABI version string (e.g., '2.9'); defines which language features are available

attach_path.description: Optional execution attachment path (e.g., '/usr/bin/myapp'); used for profile matching

audit_rules.description: List of rule types to always audit (e.g., ['capability net_admin', 'network inet tcp'])

debug.description: If true, enable debug logging for violations

capabilities.description: List of Linux capabilities (lowercase, no 'CAP_' prefix) required, e.g., ['net_bind_service']

network_rules.description: List of network rules: each is {domain, access, local?, peer?}; domain e.g. 'inet', access e.g. 'tcp', local e.g. 'port=8080', peer e.g. '127.0.0.1'

file_rules.description: List of file rules: each is {owner?, type, path, access?, target?}; access e.g. 'rwl', target e.g. 'unconfined' for exec transitions

signal_rules.description: List of signal rules: each is {access?, set?, peer?}; set is list of signal names like ['term', 'hup']; peer is label string

unix_rules.description: List of Unix socket rules: each is {access?, type?, protocol?, local?, peer?}; e.g. access='connect', local='addr=@/tmp/foo'

dbus_rules.description: List of DBus rules: each is {access?, bus?, name?, path?, interface?, member?, peer?}; bus e.g. 'system'

mount_rules.description: List of mount rules: each is {access, fstype?, options?, source, dest}; e.g. access='mount', source='/dev/sda1', dest='/mnt/data'

rlimit_rules.description: List of rlimit rules: each is {resource, operator?, value?}; resource e.g. 'nofile', value e.g. '1024' or '1G'

change_profile_rules.description: List of change_profile rules: each is {exec_mode?, exec_cond?, target}; target is target profile name

allow_all.description: If true, adds 'all,' rule (allows everything — for testing only)
